text:
sam: thinking out loud — we should add a small guided modal to the deploy bot that walks you through pinning, canary %, and a one-click rollback plan. make it opinionated but editable.

maya: +1. spent 20m last week hunting for the correct fallback target during a rollback. a guided flow would save time. :pray:

julian: agree. also let's include a release-note template option in the modal so product can fill a single short form. command sketch: `/deploy start --env prod --pin v1.4.2 --canary 10 --cw "2024-12-21 02:00-04:00" --notify #oncall`

lee: can we add a `--fast-rollback` toggle that (1) re-pins previous stable, (2) triggers safety-runbook, (3) posts a brief summary to #incidents? low-latency escape hatch.

ana: small nit — show the current pinned version and last successful commit in the dialog. let oncall approve with :white_check_mark: reaction to avoid typing.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy created by @sam for prod pin v1.4.2 (id: deploy-20241221-0130). will post canary metrics to the deploy thread. :robot_face:

sam: sketch of the release-note template I had in mind (put this behind a "use template" checkbox in the modal):
```
Release title: short summary (1 line)
Why: 1-2 bullets explaining customer impact
Rollout: canary 10% -> 100% over 15m
Fallback: revert to v1.4.1, disable feature-flag XYZ
Notes: known issues, infra changes, migrations
```

maya: path for templates and small helper scripts: `infra/deploy/templates/release_note.md` and `infra/deploy/bin/generate_rollback_pr.sh` — keep scripts tiny and tested.

julian: + add auto-generation of the rollback PR: when deploy succeeds, bot posts a link to a prefilled PR that re-pins previous commit. saves manual revert steps.

lee: CI suggestion: add a `deploy/dry-run` job that validates the modal inputs and runs lint on the generated release note. fail fast.

ana: on change windows — modal should highlight overlap with scheduled maint windows and auto-suggest quiet-window if conflict. also allow `opt-in` page for marketing notifications.

sam: proposed action items: 1) I will open an RFC with flow mockups and modal fields. 2) Maya, can you prototype the modal HTML/UX? 3) Julian, can you stub the rollback-pr generator + API for prefilled PRs? 4) Lee, add the dry-run validator to CI.

maya: yep, I'll prototype and try to keep it under 2 days.

julian: I'll sketch the PR endpoint and share an example payload. sample payload: 
```json
{
  "repo": "infra/deploy",
  "branch": "rollback/v1.4.1",
  "title": "rollback: pin -> v1.4.1",
  "body": "Auto-generated rollback PR: re-pin to v1.4.1"
}
```

lee: I'll add `deploy/dry-run` pipeline and a small linter rule for release notes.

ana: +1 to all. also request we include a simple telemetry event for `deploy.modal_shown` / `deploy.fast_rollback_used` so we can measure adoption.

sam: ok will file RFC and link todos in the thread. if anyone has objections speak now, otherwise i'll assign tickets tomorrow. :thumbsup:
